points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers read correctly, with digits and symbols in the right order?
Does the first day column of the calendar show Saturday?
Are the previous and next month arrows both beside the month name, pointing in opposite directions?
Are the time slots from 9:00 to 12:00 every 30 minutes all there and in order?
Is the doctor name shown in Arabic and easy to read?
Is the Confirm booking button easy to spot and its label readable?
